pages.title: Element conversion
pages.text: Conversion and shape are separate runes. Fire and water can create fire and water; light creates temporary illumination, darkness extinguishes lights, and positive arcane can pass through blocks.

Inverse arcane cancels other elements, including their inverses, one-to-one in arrival order within one contact. Pure mana is unaffected; excess negation deals no arcane damage. Lightning beams chain; fire fans spray flame. Valid targets and permissions still apply.
